name: PFL Infotech Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1993, PFL Infotech Ltd is in the business of trading[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2][3]
The company initially operated in the poultry sector before diversifying into software, electromechanical components, and allied services. At present, it is engaged only in trading operations and is in the process of selecting a new business direction.

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
